title: Checkout advance
sub: Who is asked to pay ahead at checkout, and how much. Its own panel: the risk score's settings are not changed here.

master.title: Advance-payment checkout
master.on: On — a flagged customer pays ahead; Cash on Delivery is not offered to him
master.off: Off — every customer sees the checkout as before
master.hint: A customer is only checked once he has filled in his name, phone and address. He never sees a score or a reason, only one line about paying ahead.

safe.title: Nothing is blocked or priced again.
safe.text: A flagged customer can still order: he pays the advance with bKash, Nagad or a card and the rest on delivery. Prices, charges and discounts stay exactly as they are.

layers.title: Layers
layers.sub: Tried from the top. The first layer that matches decides what the customer is asked for.
layers.none: No layer yet. Add one to say what counts as a flag.
layers.name: Name (for the team only)
layers.removeNote: Taken off: it is archived, never deleted; past flags keep its name.
layers.flagTitle: What counts as a flag (any one is enough)
layers.needOne: Choose at least one condition — a layer never flags everyone.

askHint.NONE: Use it to let a group through before a stricter layer below.
askHint.DELIVERY_CHARGE: Paid now; the rest on delivery. When delivery is free nothing is asked.
askHint.PART_AMOUNT: This percentage of what is due, paid now; the rest on delivery.
askHint.FULL_AMOUNT: Everything paid now; no Cash on Delivery.

saved: Saved — the audit log has it
readOnly: You can see the layers. Changing them needs the "Risk rules: change" permission (risk.rules.write).

effects.who: A customer one of your layers flags is asked to pay ahead, once he has filled everything in
effects.cod: Cash on Delivery is not offered to him; bKash, Nagad and card stay open
effects.words: He sees one neutral line, never a score or a reason
effects.price: No price, charge or discount changes

errors.STALE: Someone else changed the layers. The page shows theirs now; change it again if needed.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This needs the "Risk rules: change" permission.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: A layer is not complete: give it a name and at least one condition, and a part between 1 and 99.
errors.NOT_FOUND: A layer was removed meanwhile. Reload the page.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again.
errors.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
errors.server-error: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
